BOL4

BOL4 is singer-songwriter Ahn Ji-young’s pop project. Her songs explore the candid feelings of youth, from the excitement of a new relationship to the ache of growing apart.

POP / 2023

Eternal love사랑할 수밖에

Live performance

View release on Apple Music ↗

“Eternal love” (사랑할 수밖에) appeared on the 2023 EP Merry Go Round. BOL4’s own clip from the 2024 Bloom concert presents it through Ahn Ji-young’s live performance. The English title follows the release’s international catalogue.
